feat: make xpath.rs the one XPath 1.0 boundary (ac-46638)

runtime_core/xpath.rs is now the only Uppsala owner. One shared
parse/version/namespace setup backs two crate-private entry points:
read-only evaluation (EBV, normalized value, cardinality) and
replacement (node mutation plus serialization, moved from payload.rs,
which keeps dispatch, warning cardinality, and unchanged-body policy).

Version routing, superseding Decision 3 (ac-bd441): explicit xpath-10
alone evaluates. The omitted form - which the specification defaults
to xpath-31 - and every other 5.8.12.1 token are rejected before
evaluation: a criterion fails with an error, a selector yields null
with exactly one warning, a replacement leaves the body unchanged with
exactly one warning. Unknown tokens keep their invalid-metadata
message. Validation still accepts every table token as metadata.

Selector normalization preserves native scalar types: booleans and
integer-collapsed finite numbers stay typed, empty scalar strings and
empty-text nodes are count-one strings, attribute nodes yield their
values (previously Null), only an empty node-set is null/count 0, and
non-finite numbers fail visibly while EBV remains usable. The interim
stringly pin test is replaced by the typed contract.

The document element's non-empty prefix bindings are registered on the
evaluator, so prefixed name tests resolve by namespace URI at root
scope: equal local names under different URIs are distinguishable and
two prefixes bound to one URI unify.

Bare //... outputs and debugger watches route explicitly to XPath 1.0
and keep their degrade-to-null contract. engine_soap fixtures and the
shipped SOAP example declare xpath-10; README documents the routing.
New focused integration target tests/xpath_semantics.rs proves all
three caller surfaces at the engine level. Conformance audit F19
updated. No manifest or lockfile changes.
